issues.description: The problem statement and UML specify addGuestStudents(int) but the template's Lecture.java declares addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents, boolean validateInput) while the solution uses addGuestStudents(int). This parameter mismatch will confuse students and cause compilation/test failures if automated tests or instructions call addGuestStudents(int).
issues.suggestedFix: Align the template with the problem statement and solution by changing the template method signature to public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents) and implement the body (or, if input validation is intended, provide an overload or internal validation without changing the public API). Ensure the UML, problem text, template, and solution consistently use the same parameter list.
